title: Marketing site
summary: The public website: home, about, contact with its sent state, privacy, terms, and the page a missing address shows, plus the article templates (the article list with its empty state, an article, and a topic) that CMS entries render into. Composed from the system's layout pieces and components. Starter pages; replace them with the client's.

journeys.title: Getting in touch
journeys.summary: A visitor arrives on the home page, opens the contact page, and sends the form. Every path a visitor moves through in order is declared like this: steps, each with the screens the visitor meets, and branches for the screens met instead (an error, an empty list).

steps.title: Arrive
steps.summary: The home page is where most visitors start.

screens.label: Home
screens.note: The headline and the call to action that leads to the contact page.

steps.title: Write
steps.summary: The form, then what the visitor sees once it is sent.

screens.label: Message sent
screens.note: The thanks and the way back home.

journeys.title: Reading an article
journeys.summary: A visitor opens the article list, reads an article, and follows its topic to more like it. The list, the article, and the topic are templates: the design is here, and the content is CMS entries.

branches.label: No articles yet
branches.note: What the list shows before anything is published.

steps.title: Read
steps.summary: The article: its header, then the body.

screens.label: Article
screens.note: One of every element an article body may contain.

steps.title: Follow a topic
steps.summary: A topic link leads to the articles that share it.
